step1.title: Build Your Inventory
step1.subtitle: Every fortune starts with what you own.
step1.description: Track stocks, crypto, real estate and more. Fortuna fetches live prices automatically so your net worth is always up to date.

step2.title: Manage Your Accounts
step2.subtitle: Know exactly where your money sits.
step2.description: Add your bank accounts, then set up recurring inflows and outflows. Fortuna projects your balance forward so you can plan ahead with confidence.

step3.title: Organize by Entity
step3.subtitle: One app. All your finances.
step3.description: Group your wealth under Personal or Company entities. Switch between them instantly and see each one's total value at a glance.
